description: This file defines an interface for bracketed univariate real root-finding algorithms in the Apache Commons Math library. It specifies methods for solving equations within an interval with guaranteed bracketing, supporting different types of allowed solutions.

classes.name: BracketedUnivariateSolver
classes.description: An interface for root-finding algorithms that keep the solution bracketed within an interval, ensuring convergence and allowing control over the solution accuracy.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Finds a zero of the function within a given interval, respecting the maximum evaluations and allowed solution type.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Finds a zero of the function within a given interval, starting from a specified start value, respecting the maximum evaluations and allowed solution type.
